title: पञ्चषष्टितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Kanva is away, and the king is welcomed by the beautiful Shakuntala. Asked how a sage's daughter came to be, she begins the story of her birth: Indra, fearing Vishvamitra's austerities, sent the apsaras Menaka to distract him.
summary.kn: ಕಣ್ವರು ಹೊರಗೆ ಹೋಗಿರುವಾಗ ಸುಂದರಿ ಶಕುಂತಲೆ ರಾಜನನ್ನು ಸ್ವಾಗತಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಋಷಿಗೆ ಮಗಳು ಹೇಗೆ ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ, ವಿಶ್ವಾಮಿತ್ರನ ತಪಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಹೆದರಿದ ಇಂದ್ರನು ಅವನನ್ನು ಮರುಳುಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಮೇನಕೆಯನ್ನು ಕಳುಹಿಸಿದ ತನ್ನ ಜನ್ಮಕಥೆ ಹೇಳತೊಡಗುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: कण्व बाहर गए हैं, और सुन्दरी शकुन्तला राजा का स्वागत करती हैं। ऋषि की पुत्री कैसे हुई, यह पूछे जाने पर वे अपने जन्म की कथा सुनाने लगती हैं: विश्वामित्र के तप से डरे इन्द्र ने उन्हें विचलित करने के लिए अप्सरा मेनका को भेजा।
summary.te: కణ్వుడు బయటకు వెళ్లి ఉండగా సుందరి శకుంతల రాజుకు స్వాగతం పలుకుతుంది. ఋషికి కుమార్తె ఎలా అని అడగగా, విశ్వామిత్రుని తపస్సుకు భయపడిన ఇంద్రుడు ఆయనను చలింపజేయడానికి మేనకను పంపిన తన జన్మకథను చెప్పడం ప్రారంభిస్తుంది.
summary.ta: கண்வர் வெளியே சென்றிருக்க, அழகி ஶகுந்தலை மன்னனை வரவேற்கிறாள். முனிவருக்கு மகள் எப்படி என்று கேட்கப்பட்டபோது, விஶ்வாமித்ரரின் தவத்துக்கு அஞ்சிய இந்திரன் அவரைக் கலைக்க அப்ஸரஸ் மேனகையை அனுப்பிய தன் பிறப்புக் கதையைச் சொல்லத் தொடங்குகிறாள்.
summary.ml: കണ്വൻ ആശ്രമത്തിലില്ല; സുന്ദരിയായ ശകുന്തള രാജാവിനെ സ്വീകരിക്കുന്നു. ഋഷീപുത്രി എങ്ങനെയുണ്ടായി എന്ന് ചോദിക്കപ്പെട്ട അവൾ, ജനനകഥ തുടങ്ങുന്നു: വിശ്വാമിത്രന്റെ തപസ്സിൽ ഭയന്ന ഇന്ദ്രൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ വ്യതിചലിപ്പിക്കാൻ അപ്സരസ്സായ മേനകയെ അയച്ചു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.65; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततो गच्छन्महाबाहुरेकोऽमात्यान्विसृज्य तान् ।
नापश्यदाश्रमे तस्मिंस्तमृषिं संशितव्रतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty-armed king, going on alone after sending his ministers away, did not see in that hermitage the sage of strict vows.

verses.text:
सोऽपश्यमानस्तमृषिं शून्यं दृष्ट्वा तमाश्रमम् ।
उवाच क इहेत्युच्चैर्वनं संनादयन्निव ॥

meaning.en: Not seeing the sage and finding the hermitage empty, he called out loudly "Who is here?", making the forest echo.

verses.text:
श्रुत्वाथ तस्य तं शब्दं कन्या श्रीरिव रूपिणी ।
निश्चक्रामाश्रमात्तस्मात्तापसीवेषधारिणी ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his voice, a girl as beautiful as Shri herself came out of the hermitage, dressed as an ascetic.

verses.text:
सा तं दृष्ट्वैव राजानं दुःषन्तमसितेक्षणा ।
स्वागतं त इति क्षिप्रमुवाच प्रतिपूज्य च ॥

meaning.en: The dark-eyed girl, as soon as she saw King Dushyanta, quickly said "Welcome to you" and honored him.

verses.text:
आसनेनार्चयित्वा च पाद्येनार्घ्येण चैव हि ।
पप्रच्छानामयं राजन्कुशलं च नराधिपम् ॥

meaning.en: She honored him with a seat, water for the feet and the guest offering, and asked the king about his health and welfare.

verses.text:
यथावदर्चयित्वा सा पृष्ट्वा चानामयं तदा ।
उवाच स्मयमानेव किं कार्यं क्रियतामिति ॥

meaning.en: Having honored him properly and asked after his well-being, she said, as if smiling, "What shall be done for you?"

verses.text:
तामब्रवीत्ततो राजा कन्यां मधुरभाषिणीम् ।
दृष्ट्वा सर्वानवद्याङ्गीं यथावत्प्रतिपूजितः ॥

meaning.en: The king, honored as was fitting and seeing that sweet-spoken girl, flawless in every limb, said to her:

verses.text:
आगतोऽहं महाभागमृषिं कण्वमुपासितुम् ।
क्व गतो भगवान्भद्रे तन्ममाचक्ष्व शोभने ॥

meaning.en: "I have come to attend the great and fortunate sage Kanva. Where has the venerable one gone, good lady? Tell me, lovely one."

verses.text: शकुन्तलोवाच

meaning.en: Shakuntala said:

verses.text:
गतः पिता मे भगवान्फलान्याहर्तुमाश्रमात् ।
मुहूर्तं संप्रतीक्षस्व द्रक्ष्यस्येनमिहागतम् ॥

meaning.en: "My father, the venerable one, has gone out of the hermitage to fetch fruit. Wait a moment; you will see him when he arrives."

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
अपश्यमानस्तमृषिं तया चोक्तस्तथा नृपः ।
तां च दृष्ट्वा वरारोहां श्रीमतीं चारुहासिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: Not seeing the sage and so addressed by her, the king looked at her, graceful, glorious, with a charming smile.

verses.text:
विभ्राजमानां वपुषा तपसा च दमेन च ।
रूपयौवनसंपन्नामित्युवाच महीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: She shone in body, in austerity and in self-control, endowed with beauty and youth. The king said to her:

verses.text:
कासि कस्यासि सुश्रोणि किमर्थं चागता वनम् ।
एवंरूपगुणोपेता कुतस्त्वमसि शोभने ॥

meaning.en: "Who are you, whose daughter, fair-hipped one, and why have you come to the forest? Whence are you, lovely, with such beauty and qualities?"

verses.text:
दर्शनादेव हि शुभे त्वया मेऽपहृतं मनः ।
इच्छामि त्वामहं ज्ञातुं तन्ममाचक्ष्व शोभने ॥

meaning.en: "At the mere sight of you, fair one, you have stolen my mind. I wish to know about you; tell me, lovely lady."

verses.text:
एवमुक्ता तदा कन्या तेन राज्ञा तदाश्रमे ।
उवाच हसती वाक्यमिदं सुमधुराक्षरम् ॥

meaning.en: So addressed by the king in the hermitage, the girl laughed and spoke these sweetly worded words.

verses.text:
कण्वष्याहं भगवतो दुःषन्त दुहिता मता ।
तपस्विनो धृतिमतो धर्मज्ञस्य यशस्विनः ॥

meaning.en: "I am considered, Dushyanta, the daughter of the venerable Kanva, an ascetic, steadfast, a knower of dharma and renowned."

verses.text: दुःषन्त उवाच

meaning.en: Dushyanta said:

verses.text:
ऊर्ध्वरेता महाभागो भगवाँल्लोकपूजितः ।
चलेद्धि वृत्ताद्धर्मोऽपि न चलेत्संशितव्रतः ॥

meaning.en: "The venerable and fortunate one, honored by the world, has seed held upward in celibacy. Dharma itself might slip from its course, but a man of strict vows would not."

verses.text:
कथं त्वं तस्य दुहिता संभूता वरवर्णिनी ।
संशयो मे महानत्र तं मे छेत्तुमिहार्हसि ॥

meaning.en: "How, then, could you, fair-complexioned one, be born as his daughter? I have a great doubt about this, and you should clear it for me."

verses.text: शकुन्तलोवाच

meaning.en: Shakuntala said:

verses.text:
यथायमागमो मह्यं यथा चेदमभूत्पुरा ।
शृणु राजन्यथातत्त्वं यथास्मि दुहिता मुनेः ॥

meaning.en: "Hear, king, how it came to me, as it happened before, and how I am the sage's daughter."

verses.text:
ऋषिः कश्चिदिहागम्य मम जन्माभ्यचोदयत् ।
तस्मै प्रोवाच भगवान्यथा तच्छृणु पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: "A certain sage once came here and asked about my birth. The venerable one told him as follows; listen, lord of the earth."

verses.text:
तप्यमानः किल पुरा विश्वामित्रो महत्तपः ।
सुभृशं तापयामास शक्रं सुरगणेश्वरम् ॥

meaning.en: "Long ago, they say, Vishvamitra, performing great austerity, tormented Indra, lord of the hosts of gods, very greatly."

verses.text:
तपसा दीप्तवीर्योऽयं स्थानान्मां च्यावयेदिति ।
भीतः पुरंदरस्तस्मान्मेनकामिदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: "Indra, afraid that this man, with strength blazing from austerity, might make him fall from his place, spoke to Menaka."

verses.text:
गुणैर्दिव्यैरप्सरसां मेनके त्वं विशिष्यसे ।
श्रेयो मे कुरु कल्याणि यत्त्वां वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु ॥

meaning.en: "Menaka, among the apsarases you excel in divine qualities. Do me a favor, gracious one; hear what I tell you."

verses.text:
असावादित्यसंकाशो विश्वामित्रो महातपाः ।
तप्यमानस्तपो घोरं मम कम्पयते मनः ॥

meaning.en: "This Vishvamitra, of great austerity, bright as the sun, by practicing terrible austerity makes my mind tremble."

verses.text:
मेनके तव भारोऽयं विश्वामित्रः सुमध्यमे ।
संशितात्मा सुदुर्धर्ष उग्रे तपसि वर्तते ॥

meaning.en: "Menaka, this task is yours, slender-waisted: Vishvamitra, with disciplined self, hard to withstand, is engaged in fierce austerity."

verses.text:
स मां न च्यावयेत्स्थानात्तं वै गत्वा प्रलोभय ।
चर तस्य तपोविघ्नं कुरु मे प्रियमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: "Let him not make me fall from my place. Go and tempt him; obstruct his austerity and do me the greatest service."

verses.text:
रूपयौवनमाधुर्यचेष्टितस्मितभाषितैः ।
लोभयित्वा वरारोहे तपसः संनिवर्तय ॥

meaning.en: "With beauty, youth, sweetness, gestures, smiles and words, lovely one, tempt him and turn him back from his austerity."

verses.text: मेनकोवाच

meaning.en: Menaka said:

verses.text:
महातेजाः स भगवान्सदैव च महातपाः ।
कोपनश्च तथा ह्येनं जानाति भगवानपि ॥

meaning.en: "That venerable one is very powerful and always of great austerity, and he is quick to anger; even you know him well, lord."

verses.text:
तेजसस्तपसश्चैव कोपस्य च महात्मनः ।
त्वमप्युद्विजसे यस्य नोद्विजेयमहं कथम् ॥

meaning.en: "Of his splendor, austerity and the anger of that great soul, even you are afraid. How should I not be afraid?"

verses.text:
महाभागं वसिष्ठं यः पुत्रैरिष्टैर्व्ययोजयत् ।
क्षत्रे जातश्च यः पूर्वमभवद्ब्राह्मणो बलात् ॥

meaning.en: "He is the one who separated the fortunate Vasishtha from his dear sons, who was born a kshatriya and by force became a brahmin,"

verses.text:
शौचार्थं यो नदीं चक्रे दुर्गमां बहुभिर्जलैः ।
यां तां पुण्यतमां लोके कौशिकीति विदुर्जनाः ॥

meaning.en: "who, for the sake of purity, made a river hard to cross, with many waters, which people know as the most holy Kaushiki in the world,"

verses.text:
बभार यत्रास्य पुरा काले दुर्गे महात्मनः ।
दारान्मतङ्गो धर्मात्मा राजर्षिर्व्याधतां गतः ॥

meaning.en: "where in a famine long ago, he supported the wife of the great soul Matanga, the royal sage who had become a hunter."

verses.text:
अतीतकाले दुर्भिक्षे यत्रैत्य पुनराश्रमम् ।
मुनिः पारेति नद्या वै नाम चक्रे तदा प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: "There, the lord of sages, after the time of famine had passed, returned to the hermitage and named the river Para, 'the crossing'."

verses.text:
मतङ्गं याजयां चक्रे यत्र प्रीतमनाः स्वयम् ।
त्वं च सोमं भयाद्यस्य गतः पातुं शुरेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: "There he himself, pleased in mind, performed the sacrifice for Matanga, and you, chief of gods, went there out of fear to drink the soma."

verses.text:
अति नक्षत्रवंशांश्च क्रुद्धो नक्षत्रसंपदा ।
प्रति श्रवणपूर्वाणि नक्षत्राणि ससर्ज यः ॥

meaning.en: "In anger he created other stars, beginning with Shravana, surpassing the lines of stars through the wealth of stars."

verses.text:
एतानि यस्य कर्माणि तस्याहं भृशमुद्विजे ।
यथा मां न दहेत्क्रुद्धस्तथाज्ञापय मां विभो ॥

meaning.en: "Such are his deeds, and I am greatly afraid of him. Instruct me, lord, so that he will not burn me in anger."

verses.text:
तेजसा निर्दहेल्लोकान्कम्पयेद्धरणीं पदा ।
संक्षिपेच्च महामेरुं तूर्णमावर्तयेत्तथा ॥

meaning.en: "By his splendor he could burn the worlds, shake the earth with his foot, crush Mount Meru and spin it quickly."

verses.text:
तादृशं तपसा युक्तं प्रदीप्तमिव पावकम् ।
कथमस्मद्विधा बाला जितेन्द्रियमभिस्पृशेत् ॥

meaning.en: "How could a girl like me touch one so endowed with austerity, blazing like fire, with senses conquered?"

verses.text:
हुताशनमुखं दीप्तं सूर्यचन्द्राक्षितारकम् ।
कालजिह्वं सुरश्रेष्ठ कथमस्मद्विधा स्पृशेत् ॥

meaning.en: "How could one like me touch him, best of gods, who has the fire for his mouth, the sun, moon and stars for his eyes, and Death's tongue?"

verses.text:
यमश्च सोमश्च महर्षयश्च
साध्या विश्वे वालखिल्याश्च सर्वे ।
एतेऽपि यस्योद्विजन्ते प्रभावा-
त्कस्मात्तस्मान्मादृशी नोद्विजेत ॥

meaning.en: "Yama, Soma, the great sages, the Sadhyas, the Vishvedevas and the Valakhilyas are all afraid of his power. Why should one like me not be afraid of him?"

verses.text:
त्वयैवमुक्ता च कथं समीप-
मृषेर्न गच्छेयमहं सुरेन्द्र ।
रक्षां तु मे चिन्तय देवराज
यथा त्वदर्थं रक्षिताहं चरेयम् ॥

meaning.en: "So spoken to by you, how can I not go near the sage, lord of the gods? But think of my protection, king of the gods, so that I may go about protected, for your sake."

verses.text:
कामं तु मे मारुतस्तत्र वासः
प्रक्रीडिताया विवृणोतु देव ।
भवेच्च मे मन्मथस्तत्र कार्ये
सहायभूतस्तव देवप्रसादात् ॥

meaning.en: "Let the Wind, as I play there, blow away my garment as he wishes, god; and let Kama be my helper in that task, by your favor, god."

verses.text:
वनाच्च वायुः सुरभिः प्रवाये-
त्तस्मिन्काले तमृषिं लोभयन्त्याः ।
तथेत्युक्त्वा विहिते चैव तस्मिं-
स्ततो ययौ साश्रमं कौशिकस्य ॥

meaning.en: "And let a fragrant wind blow from the forest at that time, while I am tempting the sage." Having said "So be it," and with that arranged, she went to the hermitage of Kaushika.
